packages.name: Via Stitching Generator (KiCad 10)
packages.description: Generate via stitching for PCB copper zones. Fork of JS Reynaud's ViaStitching plugin with KiCad 10 support and a Chinese UI.
packages.description_full:
Adds a "Via Stitching Generator" action to the PCB editor that fills copper zones with stitching vias (rectangular grid, concentric rings, or along the zone outline).

This is a KiCad 10 compatibility fork of the ViaStitching plugin from jsreynaud/kicad-action-scripts. Fixes included:
- KiCad 10 BOARD.GetBoardPolygonOutlines() signature change
- Correct integer major-version checks ("10.0.6" no longer compares as < "7")
- GetAssignedPriority() instead of the removed GetPriority()
- PCB_VIA.GetWidth() layer argument on KiCad 10
- Multi-layer concentric/outline mode no longer reports "No areas to fill"
- wx sizer assertion in the parameter dialog

The user interface has been translated to Simplified Chinese. Vias are added to a group named "ViaStitching <net>" so they can be selected and deleted together.

After running the tool, refill all zones (Edit -> Fill All Zones, or press B).
